state.title: Civa game snapshot (the fields an importer fills)

id.description: Roster ids are 1-64 of A-Za-z0-9_.- and must not be an account id; city-state players are `CITY_STATE:<id>` and the free-cities player has its own id.

players.description: Roster players in seat order, then city-state players (id `citystate:<id>`) and the free-cities player. Seat i is the i-th roster player.

tileOwnership.description: City id -> owned tile positions, as Game.toJSON() writes it.

ext.description: Capability-owned state (religion, governors, policies, loyalty, …) keyed by slice id.
